newsitem.title: USA: Former Fed's Lindsey says Fed on right track.
newsitem.headline: Former Fed's Lindsey says Fed on right track.

text.p: Former Federal Reserve Board Governor Lawrence Lindsey said Friday that the Federal Reserve has undertaken the correct approach in tightening to help keep inflation at bay.
"The Fed has strategically adopted the right approach," Lindsey told a business group at the American Enterprise Institute, where he is now a resident scholar.
"Tightening is not an unreasonable thing to do," he said.

The former Fed official, who left the central bank in February, also said that the fundamentals continue to point to a strong dollar and that he doubted attempts to jawbone the currency down would have any lasting impact.
